exclusionCategories.note: Administrative organization-management routes are excluded from MCP tools and raw fallback.
API key lifecycle and reissue routes are excluded for security.
Billing, subscription, promotions, and payment-related routes are excluded.
Provider callback/action endpoints are excluded because they are server-to-server callbacks.
OAuth bootstrap, token exchange, and discovery routes are excluded from exposure.
Enterprise SCIM provisioning routes are excluded.
Internal staff-only or operator-only routes are not exposed via MCP.
Webhook administration and secret-management routes are excluded.
